title: Security Deposit Dispute - Development Fixture
text: A tenant may have a dispute when a landlord does not return a security deposit after the tenancy ends. The applicable rights and remedies depend on the tenancy agreement, the reason for withholding the deposit, the facts of the dispute, and applicable law.

title: Rent Dispute - Development Fixture
text: Rent disputes can involve unpaid rent, excessive deductions from a security deposit, disagreements about the tenancy agreement, or disputes concerning possession. The relevant facts and applicable legal provisions should be verified before giving a legal explanation.

title: Unpaid Salary - Development Fixture
text: A worker may raise a dispute when wages or salary have not been paid. The employment arrangement, amount owed, payment period, employment records, and applicable labour provisions should be considered.

title: Employment Termination - Development Fixture
text: An employment termination dispute may depend on the employment arrangement, reason for termination, notice requirements, employment records, and applicable labour provisions.

title: Workplace Harassment - Development Fixture
text: A workplace harassment complaint may require details about the conduct, workplace, dates, people involved, reporting history, and applicable workplace procedures.
